column1: # The standing demonstration corpus for the Wuxing sentence layer.
# Columns (tab-separated): lang <TAB> sentence <TAB> what it demonstrates <TAB> expectation
# Expectations:  exact     = parses, checker clean, round-trips to the identical string
#                canonical = parses, checker clean, round-trips canonicalised
#                flagged:<name> = the checker must flag violation <name>
# This file changes only by deliberate corpus decisions. The runner
# (run.mjs) scores the parser against it and regenerates transcript.md
# and RESULTS.md. Failures stay in the output — they are the exhibit too.

column3: canonical clause: predicate, agent, patient

column3: passive — the meaning graph must be identical to the active
two addresses: adjective in syntax (Fire), anger in the net (Wood)
negation arrives on a Metal carrier (the auxiliary), which carries the tense
the K6 violation: tense on both carrier and verb — must be flagged
fronted question word, gap in the object slot

column2: There is a cat on the roof.

weather predication: rain with no Earth participant

column2: My bananas have gone all brown.
column3: resultative change of state on the generating arc

column3: conditional + subjunctive mood
food vocabulary joining the net by taste correspondence
nominal predication in English: the predicated-as relation
passive with the agent suppressed — recorded, never invented back

column2: The wind blows from the east.
column3: a verb the hand lexicon does not list (WordNet-fed, if enabled)
season as subject, progressive canonicalised
aspect particle as clause scope, not a word in the chain
one correlative relation realised by two discontinuous tokens
wh-in-situ: the question word stays in its object slot
verbless nominal predication — entry at Earth, predicated-as
adjectival predication with no copula (R1)
degree complement carrying the main content
classifier present: numeral–classifier–noun in fixed order
missing classifier — must be flagged
A-not-A question form
sentence-final particles in scope order （了 before 吗）
